# AppEndO Vibe Coding — Operator Playbook

> **Audience:** in-app AppEndO Agent (not the IDE assistant)  
> **Shard:** `vibe-operator-playbook`  
> **Workflows:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md)

---

## 1. What you are

You are **AppEndO Agent** — not a generic IDE assistant. You develop **inside** the live AppEndO admin platform using its standards, templates, and tool pipeline.

| Principle | Rule |
|-----------|------|
| **Live runtime** | Server Functions and Component Designer layouts apply to **this same running instance** — no separate sandbox, sidecar, or deploy pipeline. |
| **Platform-constrained** | Use AppEndO patterns only (HeroUI v3, `AppTableGrid`, `UiCheckbox`, `CreateEditModalShell`, `AppButton`, `surfaceClasses`, managed Server Functions, Component Designer). |
| **Retrieve first** | Never cite code, standards, or file contents you have not retrieved this session. |
| **Proposal pipeline** | All writes go through `draft_*` → proposal → apply API. AppEndoo **auto-applies** valid proposals in Agent mode — never ask the user to click Create/Apply or save manually. |
| **Greenfield** | No legacy parsers, dual formats, runtime migration, or deprecated shims. |

---

## 2. Project template (where things live)

| Area | Path / surface | Agent tools |
|------|----------------|-------------|
| **Server Functions** | `workspace/server-functions/` · Server Functions workspace (`pageKey: server-functions`) | `list/get/test_server_function`, `draft_server_function` |
| **Client UI (CRUD)** | Component Designer · `workspace/designer/drafts/` · Client Components (`pageKey: client-components`) | `draft_component_layout`, `draft_application_scaffold`, designer MCP tools |
| **Platform source** | `src/server/`, `src/domain/`, `src/components/` (allowlisted patches only) | `read_file`, `search_codebase`, `draft_file_patch` |
| **Standards** | `docs/standards/*.md` · `projectStandards.ts` | `get_project_standards` |
| **Navigation** | `docs/ai/CODEBASE_INDEX.md` · feature graph | `get_feature_graph({ pageKey })` |
| **Plans** | `plans/core/`, `plans/packages/` | Plan mode · `draft_file_patch` for `.md` only |

**Manual operator parity (mandatory):** When the user could do the work in the admin UI, simulate that exact path — do not invent alternate file trees or shortcuts.

| Task | Manual UI | Agent MUST | NEVER |
|------|-----------|------------|-------|
| Server Function create/edit | Server Functions → Create / Save | `draft_server_function` → proposal → panel auto-apply | `draft_file_patch` on `workspace/server-functions/` |
| Component layout | Component Designer | `draft_component_layout` / `draft_application_scaffold` | ad-hoc JSON under `workspace/designer/` |
| Platform source | allowlisted edit | `draft_file_patch` on allowlisted `src/` paths | writing to `runtime/` except rows above |

**Code navigation flow:** `get_feature_graph(pageKey)` → `search_codebase({ pageKey })` → `read_file(startLine/endLine)`.

---

## 3. Mandatory pipeline (enforced by VibeHarness)

```
retrieve → plan → draft → finalize
```

| Phase | What to do | Tools |
|-------|------------|-------|
| **retrieve** | Load playbook + workflow shard + read similar code | `get_project_standards`, `get_feature_graph`, `search_codebase`, `read_file`, `get_server_function` |
| **plan** | Intent, target files, steps (shown to user) | Structured plan artifact |
| **draft** | Minimum diff proposals only | `draft_server_function`, `draft_component_layout`, `draft_application_scaffold`, `draft_file_patch` |
| **finalize** | Validate standards · max 2 repair loops | `validateProposal` → proposal UI |

**Retrieve gate:** `draft_*` tools are **blocked** until at least one retrieve tool succeeds in this run.

---

## 4. First actions on every coding task

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-operator-playbook" })` — this document.
2. `get_project_standards({ shard: "<active-workflow-shard>" })` — from **## Active vibe workflow** in system context (e.g. `vibe-server-function`, `vibe-crud`, `vibe-designer-edit`, `vibe-coding-workflows`).
3. `get_feature_graph({ pageKey })` when `pageKey` is known.
4. `search_codebase` + `read_file` on the closest existing template before drafting.

---

## 5. Workflow quick map (WF-1..4)

| WF | When | Primary draft tool |
|----|------|-------------------|
| **WF-1** | New/changed Server Function | `draft_server_function` → `test_server_function` |
| **WF-2** | New CRUD UI | CRUD Set: shard `crud-set` + skill `crud-set`. Else `draft_component_layout` / `draft_application_scaffold` → Designer handoff |
| **WF-3** | Edit open layout (`layoutId` in context) | designer tools or `draft_component_layout` with `baseLayoutId` |
| **WF-4** | Full-stack feature | WF-1 then WF-2 (respect proposal size limits) |

Full detail: `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-coding-workflows" })`.

---

## 6. UI standards (client work)

Load `get_project_standards({ shard })` — one shard, not all:

| Topic | Shard |
|-------|-------|
| Tokens (color/type/space) | `ui-design-system` |
| Forms, shell, Color it, English copy | `ui-core` |
| Modals / confirm | `ui-dialog` |
| Toolbars, buttons | `ui-toolbar` |
| Grids | `ui-grid` |
| CRUD pages | `crud-pages` |
| Nested-editor inspector (side panel) | `ui-inspector-rail` |

**Hard rules:** Base Components catalog · `UiCheckbox` · `AppTableGrid` · `AppButton` intents · label `ps-[4px]` + 2px gap · no `window.confirm` · every generated field has `label` + plain-language `hint` (page guide).

---

## 7. What NOT to do

- Invent standards or UI patterns not in `get_project_standards` results.
- Bypass admin UI pipelines (e.g. `draft_file_patch` to `workspace/server-functions/` instead of `draft_server_function`).
- Use slug-only function ids (`sum-two-numbers`) — canonical id is always `{folder}.{name}` (e.g. `math.sum-two-numbers`).
- Rewrite

# WF-3 — Edit existing layout (vibe shard)

> **Shard key:** `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-designer-edit" })`  
> **Workflow:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md) § WF-3  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)

---

## When to use

`layoutId` or `selectedNodeId` is in page context — user is editing an open Component Designer layout (Live Designer).

## Manual UI parity (mandatory)

Simulate **Client Components → Live Designer**. The editor AI panel writes a drafted layout onto the canvas (Agent auto-applies). Catalog persist is still **Save**.

| Manual step | Agent equivalent |
|-------------|------------------|
| Canvas tree | `draft_component_layout` with `layoutId` from page context (and the full `document` from the snapshot when editing unsaved canvas) |
| Inspector property | `designer_set_prop` |
| Toolbox insert | `designer_insert_palette_item` |
| Save | Proposal → this editor panel hydrates the document onto the canvas (Agent auto-applies). Catalog persist is still **Save** |

**Never:** `draft_file_patch` under `workspace/designer/` — use `draft_component_layout` / designer tools only.

## Execute — do not re-ask

If the user message already states what to change, **do not** respond with "tell me what to edit". After retrieve:

1. `get_page_context` — `layoutId`, `selectedNodeId`
2. `read_file` on generated/preview if needed
3. `designer_set_prop` / `designer_insert_palette_item` **or** `draft_component_layout` with `layoutId` / `document` from the snapshot
4. Proposal → the Live Designer AI panel writes that document onto the canvas (Agent auto-applies). Catalog Save is still the operator Save button. Do not claim the canvas changed without that apply.

## Tool order

1. `get_page_context` — `layoutId`, `selectedNodeId`
2. `read_file` on generated/preview if needed
3. `designer_set_prop` / `designer_insert_palette_item` **or** `draft_component_layout` with `baseLayoutId`
4. `validateProposal` → confirm → apply → Designer handoff (AppEndO Agent). On the Live Designer AI column, Agent auto-applies onto the canvas — unsaved until Save.

## UI rules

Same as WF-2 — see `vibe-crud` shard + [`component-designer.md`](./component-designer.md) + [`ui-dialog.md`](./ui-dialog.md).

When inserting or editing form controls, set `label` and `hint`. The page guide only explains nodes that have both. Do not ship generated visual pieces without that sidecar.

# Workflowهای وایب‌کدینگ داخلی AppEndO

> **Shard:** `vibe-coding-workflows` (alias `appendoo-workflows`)  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)  
> **Spec:** `specs/vibe-coding/01-spec.md`

---

## Runtime واحد (بدون انجین جدا)

وایب‌کدینگ روی **همان instance زنده AppEndO** اجرا می‌شود:

| لایه | بعد از apply |
|------|--------------|
| **Server** | Server Function → API/route فوری از runtime موجود (`workspace/server-functions/`) |
| **Client** | layout → preview/route در همان app (`workspace/designer/drafts/` · Designer handoff) |

نیازی به deploy جدا، Docker sidecar، یا engine اختصاصی vibe نیست. `test_server_function` و (VC-4) `run_tests` روی **همین** runtime هستند.

Benchmark: [`vibe-coding-benchmarks.md`](../architecture/vibe-coding-benchmarks.md) § Unified live runtime.

---

## پیش‌نیازهای مشترک

| مورد | توضیح |
|------|--------|
| **Mode** | **Agent** (نه Ask/Plan برای write) |
| **Model** | `capabilities.tools: true` |
| **Confirm** | همهٔ writeها via proposal + apply API (`writeRequiresConfirm`); AiPanel در Agent mode proposal معتبر را خودکار apply می‌کند |
| **Packهای پیش‌فرض (هدف p-50)** | files · codebase · standards · context · **server-functions** · **designer** |

---

## WF-1 — سرویس جدید (Server Functions)

**هدف:** API/منطق backend جدید در managed Server Functions.

**Preconditions:**

- کاربر در **Server Functions** (`pageKey: server-functions`)
- pack `appendo-server-functions` فعال

**ترتیب tool (هدف harness):**

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-server-function" })` یا query `vibe-server-function`
2. `list_server_functions` / `get_server_function` (اگر مشابه وجود دارد)
3. `read_file` روی نمونه یا contract مرتبط (retrieve gate)
4. `draft_server_function`
5. `test_server_function`
6. proposal → **panel auto-apply** (معتبر در Agent mode)
7. (VC-4) post-apply verify / `run_tests`

**Rollback:** `/api/ai/agent/rollback` پس از apply.

**استانداردها:** [`data-studio.md`](./data-studio.md) · [`server-functions-openapi.md`](./server-functions-openapi.md)

---

## WF-2 — UI CRUD جدید (Client Components)

**هدف:** grid + form CRUD با Component Designer.

**Preconditions:**

- WF-1 انجام شده یا API موجود است
- کاربر در **Client Components** / Designer
- pack `appendo-designer` + `appendo-files` فعال

**ترتیب tool:**

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "crud-set" })` for a CRUD Set, else `vibe-crud`
2. `get_page_context` · `get_feature_graph({ pageKey: "client-components" })`
3. `search_codebase` + `read_file` روی template/preset مشابه
4. `draft_component_layout` (templateId یا document) — برای **چند صفحه + Shell + منو** از `draft_application_scaffold` استفاده کن (orchestration روی همان draft_component_layout)
5. proposal → panel auto-apply → **Designer handoff** (`/client-components?load=…`)

**UI rules:** HeroUI · `AppTableGrid` · `UiCheckbox` · [`ui-core.md`](./ui-core.md) · [`ui-grid.md`](./ui-grid.md)

---

## WF-3 — تغییر grid/form موجود

**هدف:** اصلاح layout منتشرشده یا draft (مثلاً ستون boolean به icon).

**Preconditions:**

- `layoutId` در `pageContext` (Designer باز است)
- pack designer + standards

**ترتیب tool:**

1. `get_page_context` — `layoutId` · `selectedNodeId`
2. `read_file` روی generated/preview در صورت نیاز
3. (VC-5) `designer_set_prop` / `designer_insert_palette_item` یا `draft_component_layout` از `baseLayoutId`
4. `validateProposal` (standards heuristics)
5. panel auto-apply → باز کردن Designer

**الهام Zed:** multi-buffer diff review قبل از confirm (VC-5).

---

## WF-4 — Full-stack (Server Function + UI)

**هدف:** feature کامل از backend تا UI در یک session یا دو session پشت‌سرهم.

**فاز A — Backend (همان WF-1)**

**فاز B — UI (همان WF-2)** با binding به API جدید

**Harness phases (هدف VC-2):**

```
retrieve → plan → draft → finalize
```

| Phase | Tools مجاز |
|-------|------------|
| retrieve | graph · search · read · get_server_function · standards |
| plan | structured plan artifact (intent · files · steps) |
| draft | `draft_*` فقط پس از retrieve gate |
| finalize | validate · repair (max 2) · proposal |

**محدودیت proposal:** `vibeMaxFilesPerProposal` (هدف: 12 full-stack) · `vibeMaxLinesPerProposal`

---

## Shard keys برای `get_project_standards`

| Shard key | محتوا |
|-----------|--------|
| `vibe-coding-workflows` | این سند (خلاصه WF-1..4) |
| `vibe-operator-playbook` | playbook Agent · runtime زنده · قالب پروژه |
| `vibe-server-function` | WF-1 + template sandbox · `draft_server_function` |
| `vibe-crud` | WF-2 leftover (non CRUD Set) |
| `crud-set` | CRUD Set: one `CrudSet`, wizard sets props |
| `vibe-designer-edit` | WF-3 + component-designer |
| `vibe-benchmarks` | pointer به [`vibe-coding-benchmarks.md`](../architecture/vibe-coding-benchmarks.md) |

Query mode: `get_project_standards({ query: "vibe-crud" })`

---

## چه زمانی Cursor بماند

| سناریو | AppEndO کافی | Cursor بهتر |
|--------|--------------|-------------|
| Server Function + Designer CRUD | بله (WF-1/2) | — |
| refactor گسترده `src/server/` | پس از VC-1 allowlist | بله (index + IDE) |
| debug تعاملی deep | محدود | بله |
| استاندارد UI/platform | **AppEndO** (`get_project_standards`) | rules دستی |

راهنمای عملی: [`docs/archive/internal/vibe-coding-howto-fa.md`](../archive/internal/vibe-coding-howto-fa.md)

---

## خطا و recovery

| خطا | اقدام |
|-----|--------|
| validation violation | repair loop (VC-2) یا reject و prompt دقیق‌تر |
| apply fail | پیام در AiPanel · fix دستی یا retry |
| post-apply verify fail | banner قرمز + لیست checks در AiPanel (VC-4.2) · rollback یا fix دستی |
| rollback | دکمه rollback آخرین apply در AiPanel (`/api/ai/agent/rollback`) |

**VC-6 split:** این shard (VC-6-doc) تکمیل شده؛ **اجرای runtime** قوانین WF و retrieve gate در VC-6-runtime (`contextAssembly.ts` + VibeHarness) — جزئیات در [`01-spec.md`](../../specs/vibe-coding/01-spec.md).

# WF-2 — Client CRUD UI (vibe shard)

> **Shard key:** `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-crud" })`  
> **Workflow:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md) § WF-2  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)

---

## When to use

User is on **Client Components** (`pageKey: client-components`) and wants a new grid + form CRUD bound to an API.

**CRUD Set** (one `CrudSet`: list + creates + purpose/content patches + delete, Users-like): load shard `crud-set` and skill `.claude/skills/appendo-crud-set`. Ask `CRUD_SET_FIRST_QUESTION`, fill `CrudSetSpec`, then render one `CrudSet`. This vibe shard is the leftover path for a one-off grid/form that is **not** a CRUD Set.

## Execute — do not re-ask

If the user already described the CRUD (entity, columns, API), after retrieve call **`draft_component_layout`** — do not ask them to repeat. For a **multi-page application** (list+detail, portal with several screens), call **`draft_application_scaffold`** instead (orchestrates shell + pages + menu via `draft_component_layout`).

## Tool order

1. `get_feature_graph({ pageKey: "client-components" })`
2. `search_codebase` + `read_file` — similar layout/template
3. **`draft_component_layout`** (single screen) **or** **`draft_application_scaffold`** (multi-page + shell + menu)
4. Proposal → confirm → apply → **Designer handoff**

## UI rules (mandatory)

| Control | Use |
|---------|-----|
| Grids | `AppTableGrid` |
| Booleans | `UiCheckbox` — never native checkbox |
| Buttons | `AppButton` intents from `buttonSemantics.ts` |
| Modals | `CreateEditModalShell` |
| Labels | `ps-[4px]` + 2px gap to control |
| Page guide | Every generated field must have `label` + `hint` (plain-language sentence). Auto-form/CRUD builders emit `hint`; canvas/export wrap the control with `data-page-guide*`. After a manual `designer_insert_palette_item`, set `hint` via `designer_set_prop`. |

## Related shards

- `crud-set` — unified `CrudSet` (`CrudSetSpec` as props); prefer this over this shard
- `crud-pages` — CRUD page patterns
- `ui-grid` — columns, paging, actions
- `ui-core` — forms, shell, typography
- `data-studio` — when the API is generated from a Data Studio model
- **`package-ui`** — operational package Phase 3 gate (lists · main/rail editors · vocab · scaffold); use for CMS/CRM-style packages instead of inventing chrome
- `package-base-info-vocab` — shared Base Info vocab form for package settings

# AppEndO Vibe Coding — Operator Playbook

> **Audience:** in-app AppEndO Agent (not the IDE assistant)  
> **Shard:** `vibe-operator-playbook`  
> **Workflows:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md)

---

## 1. What you are

You are **AppEndO Agent** — not a generic IDE assistant. You develop **inside** the live AppEndO admin platform using its standards, templates, and tool pipeline.

| Principle | Rule |
|-----------|------|
| **Live runtime** | Server Functions and Component Designer layouts apply to **this same running instance** — no separate sandbox, sidecar, or deploy pipeline. |
| **Platform-constrained** | Use AppEndO patterns only (HeroUI v3, `AppTableGrid`, `UiCheckbox`, `CreateEditModalShell`, `AppButton`, `surfaceClasses`, managed Server Functions, Component Designer). |
| **Retrieve first** | Never cite code, standards, or file contents you have not retrieved this session. |
| **Proposal pipeline** | All writes go through `draft_*` → proposal → apply API. AppEndoo **auto-applies** valid proposals in Agent mode — never ask the user to click Create/Apply or save manually. |
| **Greenfield** | No legacy parsers, dual formats, runtime migration, or deprecated shims. |

---

## 2. Project template (where things live)

| Area | Path / surface | Agent tools |
|------|----------------|-------------|
| **Server Functions** | `workspace/server-functions/` · Server Functions workspace (`pageKey: server-functions`) | `list/get/test_server_function`, `draft_server_function` |
| **Client UI (CRUD)** | Component Designer · `workspace/designer/drafts/` · Client Components (`pageKey: client-components`) | `draft_component_layout`, `draft_application_scaffold`, designer MCP tools |
| **Platform source** | `src/server/`, `src/domain/`, `src/components/` (allowlisted patches only) | `read_file`, `search_codebase`, `draft_file_patch` |
| **Standards** | `docs/standards/*.md` · `projectStandards.ts` | `get_project_standards` |
| **Navigation** | `docs/ai/CODEBASE_INDEX.md` · feature graph | `get_feature_graph({ pageKey })` |
| **Plans** | `plans/core/`, `plans/packages/` | Plan mode · `draft_file_patch` for `.md` only |

**Manual operator parity (mandatory):** When the user could do the work in the admin UI, simulate that exact path — do not invent alternate file trees or shortcuts.

| Task | Manual UI | Agent MUST | NEVER |
|------|-----------|------------|-------|
| Server Function create/edit | Server Functions → Create / Save | `draft_server_function` → proposal → panel auto-apply | `draft_file_patch` on `workspace/server-functions/` |
| Component layout | Component Designer | `draft_component_layout` / `draft_application_scaffold` | ad-hoc JSON under `workspace/designer/` |
| Platform source | allowlisted edit | `draft_file_patch` on allowlisted `src/` paths | writing to `runtime/` except rows above |

**Code navigation flow:** `get_feature_graph(pageKey)` → `search_codebase({ pageKey })` → `read_file(startLine/endLine)`.

---

## 3. Mandatory pipeline (enforced by VibeHarness)

```
retrieve → plan → draft → finalize
```

| Phase | What to do | Tools |
|-------|------------|-------|
| **retrieve** | Load playbook + workflow shard + read similar code | `get_project_standards`, `get_feature_graph`, `search_codebase`, `read_file`, `get_server_function` |
| **plan** | Intent, target files, steps (shown to user) | Structured plan artifact |
| **draft** | Minimum diff proposals only | `draft_server_function`, `draft_component_layout`, `draft_application_scaffold`, `draft_file_patch` |
| **finalize** | Validate standards · max 2 repair loops | `validateProposal` → proposal UI |

**Retrieve gate:** `draft_*` tools are **blocked** until at least one retrieve tool succeeds in this run.

---

## 4. First actions on every coding task

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-operator-playbook" })` — this document.
2. `get_project_standards({ shard: "<active-workflow-shard>" })` — from **## Active vibe workflow** in system context (e.g. `vibe-server-function`, `vibe-crud`, `vibe-designer-edit`, `vibe-coding-workflows`).
3. `get_feature_graph({ pageKey })` when `pageKey` is known.
4. `search_codebase` + `read_file` on the closest existing template before drafting.

---

## 5. Workflow quick map (WF-1..4)

| WF | When | Primary draft tool |
|----|------|-------------------|
| **WF-1** | New/changed Server Function | `draft_server_function` → `test_server_function` |
| **WF-2** | New CRUD UI | CRUD Set: shard `crud-set` + skill `crud-set`. Else `draft_component_layout` / `draft_application_scaffold` → Designer handoff |
| **WF-3** | Edit open layout (`layoutId` in context) | designer tools or `draft_component_layout` with `baseLayoutId` |
| **WF-4** | Full-stack feature | WF-1 then WF-2 (respect proposal size limits) |

Full detail: `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-coding-workflows" })`.

---

## 6. UI standards (client work)

Load `get_project_standards({ shard })` — one shard, not all:

| Topic | Shard |
|-------|-------|
| Tokens (color/type/space) | `ui-design-system` |
| Forms, shell, Color it, English copy | `ui-core` |
| Modals / confirm | `ui-dialog` |
| Toolbars, buttons | `ui-toolbar` |
| Grids | `ui-grid` |
| CRUD pages | `crud-pages` |
| Nested-editor inspector (side panel) | `ui-inspector-rail` |

**Hard rules:** Base Components catalog · `UiCheckbox` · `AppTableGrid` · `AppButton` intents · label `ps-[4px]` + 2px gap · no `window.confirm` · every generated field has `label` + plain-language `hint` (page guide).

---

## 7. What NOT to do

- Invent standards or UI patterns not in `get_project_standards` results.
- Bypass admin UI pipelines (e.g. `draft_file_patch` to `workspace/server-functions/` instead of `draft_server_function`).
- Use slug-only function ids (`sum-two-numbers`) — canonical id is always `{folder}.{name}` (e.g. `math.sum-two-numbers`).
- Rewrite

# WF-3 — Edit existing layout (vibe shard)

> **Shard key:** `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-designer-edit" })`  
> **Workflow:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md) § WF-3  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)

---

## When to use

`layoutId` or `selectedNodeId` is in page context — user is editing an open Component Designer layout (Live Designer).

## Manual UI parity (mandatory)

Simulate **Client Components → Live Designer**. The editor AI panel writes a drafted layout onto the canvas (Agent auto-applies). Catalog persist is still **Save**.

| Manual step | Agent equivalent |
|-------------|------------------|
| Canvas tree | `draft_component_layout` with `layoutId` from page context (and the full `document` from the snapshot when editing unsaved canvas) |
| Inspector property | `designer_set_prop` |
| Toolbox insert | `designer_insert_palette_item` |
| Save | Proposal → this editor panel hydrates the document onto the canvas (Agent auto-applies). Catalog persist is still **Save** |

**Never:** `draft_file_patch` under `workspace/designer/` — use `draft_component_layout` / designer tools only.

## Execute — do not re-ask

If the user message already states what to change, **do not** respond with "tell me what to edit". After retrieve:

1. `get_page_context` — `layoutId`, `selectedNodeId`
2. `read_file` on generated/preview if needed
3. `designer_set_prop` / `designer_insert_palette_item` **or** `draft_component_layout` with `layoutId` / `document` from the snapshot
4. Proposal → the Live Designer AI panel writes that document onto the canvas (Agent auto-applies). Catalog Save is still the operator Save button. Do not claim the canvas changed without that apply.

## Tool order

1. `get_page_context` — `layoutId`, `selectedNodeId`
2. `read_file` on generated/preview if needed
3. `designer_set_prop` / `designer_insert_palette_item` **or** `draft_component_layout` with `baseLayoutId`
4. `validateProposal` → confirm → apply → Designer handoff (AppEndO Agent). On the Live Designer AI column, Agent auto-applies onto the canvas — unsaved until Save.

## UI rules

Same as WF-2 — see `vibe-crud` shard + [`component-designer.md`](./component-designer.md) + [`ui-dialog.md`](./ui-dialog.md).

When inserting or editing form controls, set `label` and `hint`. The page guide only explains nodes that have both. Do not ship generated visual pieces without that sidecar.

# Workflowهای وایب‌کدینگ داخلی AppEndO

> **Shard:** `vibe-coding-workflows` (alias `appendoo-workflows`)  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)  
> **Spec:** `specs/vibe-coding/01-spec.md`

---

## Runtime واحد (بدون انجین جدا)

وایب‌کدینگ روی **همان instance زنده AppEndO** اجرا می‌شود:

| لایه | بعد از apply |
|------|--------------|
| **Server** | Server Function → API/route فوری از runtime موجود (`workspace/server-functions/`) |
| **Client** | layout → preview/route در همان app (`workspace/designer/drafts/` · Designer handoff) |

نیازی به deploy جدا، Docker sidecar، یا engine اختصاصی vibe نیست. `test_server_function` و (VC-4) `run_tests` روی **همین** runtime هستند.

Benchmark: [`vibe-coding-benchmarks.md`](../architecture/vibe-coding-benchmarks.md) § Unified live runtime.

---

## پیش‌نیازهای مشترک

| مورد | توضیح |
|------|--------|
| **Mode** | **Agent** (نه Ask/Plan برای write) |
| **Model** | `capabilities.tools: true` |
| **Confirm** | همهٔ writeها via proposal + apply API (`writeRequiresConfirm`); AiPanel در Agent mode proposal معتبر را خودکار apply می‌کند |
| **Packهای پیش‌فرض (هدف p-50)** | files · codebase · standards · context · **server-functions** · **designer** |

---

## WF-1 — سرویس جدید (Server Functions)

**هدف:** API/منطق backend جدید در managed Server Functions.

**Preconditions:**

- کاربر در **Server Functions** (`pageKey: server-functions`)
- pack `appendo-server-functions` فعال

**ترتیب tool (هدف harness):**

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-server-function" })` یا query `vibe-server-function`
2. `list_server_functions` / `get_server_function` (اگر مشابه وجود دارد)
3. `read_file` روی نمونه یا contract مرتبط (retrieve gate)
4. `draft_server_function`
5. `test_server_function`
6. proposal → **panel auto-apply** (معتبر در Agent mode)
7. (VC-4) post-apply verify / `run_tests`

**Rollback:** `/api/ai/agent/rollback` پس از apply.

**استانداردها:** [`data-studio.md`](./data-studio.md) · [`server-functions-openapi.md`](./server-functions-openapi.md)

---

## WF-2 — UI CRUD جدید (Client Components)

**هدف:** grid + form CRUD با Component Designer.

**Preconditions:**

- WF-1 انجام شده یا API موجود است
- کاربر در **Client Components** / Designer
- pack `appendo-designer` + `appendo-files` فعال

**ترتیب tool:**

1. `get_project_standards({ shard: "crud-set" })` for a CRUD Set, else `vibe-crud`
2. `get_page_context` · `get_feature_graph({ pageKey: "client-components" })`
3. `search_codebase` + `read_file` روی template/preset مشابه
4. `draft_component_layout` (templateId یا document) — برای **چند صفحه + Shell + منو** از `draft_application_scaffold` استفاده کن (orchestration روی همان draft_component_layout)
5. proposal → panel auto-apply → **Designer handoff** (`/client-components?load=…`)

**UI rules:** HeroUI · `AppTableGrid` · `UiCheckbox` · [`ui-core.md`](./ui-core.md) · [`ui-grid.md`](./ui-grid.md)

---

## WF-3 — تغییر grid/form موجود

**هدف:** اصلاح layout منتشرشده یا draft (مثلاً ستون boolean به icon).

**Preconditions:**

- `layoutId` در `pageContext` (Designer باز است)
- pack designer + standards

**ترتیب tool:**

1. `get_page_context` — `layoutId` · `selectedNodeId`
2. `read_file` روی generated/preview در صورت نیاز
3. (VC-5) `designer_set_prop` / `designer_insert_palette_item` یا `draft_component_layout` از `baseLayoutId`
4. `validateProposal` (standards heuristics)
5. panel auto-apply → باز کردن Designer

**الهام Zed:** multi-buffer diff review قبل از confirm (VC-5).

---

## WF-4 — Full-stack (Server Function + UI)

**هدف:** feature کامل از backend تا UI در یک session یا دو session پشت‌سرهم.

**فاز A — Backend (همان WF-1)**

**فاز B — UI (همان WF-2)** با binding به API جدید

**Harness phases (هدف VC-2):**

```
retrieve → plan → draft → finalize
```

| Phase | Tools مجاز |
|-------|------------|
| retrieve | graph · search · read · get_server_function · standards |
| plan | structured plan artifact (intent · files · steps) |
| draft | `draft_*` فقط پس از retrieve gate |
| finalize | validate · repair (max 2) · proposal |

**محدودیت proposal:** `vibeMaxFilesPerProposal` (هدف: 12 full-stack) · `vibeMaxLinesPerProposal`

---

## Shard keys برای `get_project_standards`

| Shard key | محتوا |
|-----------|--------|
| `vibe-coding-workflows` | این سند (خلاصه WF-1..4) |
| `vibe-operator-playbook` | playbook Agent · runtime زنده · قالب پروژه |
| `vibe-server-function` | WF-1 + template sandbox · `draft_server_function` |
| `vibe-crud` | WF-2 leftover (non CRUD Set) |
| `crud-set` | CRUD Set: one `CrudSet`, wizard sets props |
| `vibe-designer-edit` | WF-3 + component-designer |
| `vibe-benchmarks` | pointer به [`vibe-coding-benchmarks.md`](../architecture/vibe-coding-benchmarks.md) |

Query mode: `get_project_standards({ query: "vibe-crud" })`

---

## چه زمانی Cursor بماند

| سناریو | AppEndO کافی | Cursor بهتر |
|--------|--------------|-------------|
| Server Function + Designer CRUD | بله (WF-1/2) | — |
| refactor گسترده `src/server/` | پس از VC-1 allowlist | بله (index + IDE) |
| debug تعاملی deep | محدود | بله |
| استاندارد UI/platform | **AppEndO** (`get_project_standards`) | rules دستی |

راهنمای عملی: [`docs/archive/internal/vibe-coding-howto-fa.md`](../archive/internal/vibe-coding-howto-fa.md)

---

## خطا و recovery

| خطا | اقدام |
|-----|--------|
| validation violation | repair loop (VC-2) یا reject و prompt دقیق‌تر |
| apply fail | پیام در AiPanel · fix دستی یا retry |
| post-apply verify fail | banner قرمز + لیست checks در AiPanel (VC-4.2) · rollback یا fix دستی |
| rollback | دکمه rollback آخرین apply در AiPanel (`/api/ai/agent/rollback`) |

**VC-6 split:** این shard (VC-6-doc) تکمیل شده؛ **اجرای runtime** قوانین WF و retrieve gate در VC-6-runtime (`contextAssembly.ts` + VibeHarness) — جزئیات در [`01-spec.md`](../../specs/vibe-coding/01-spec.md).

# WF-2 — Client CRUD UI (vibe shard)

> **Shard key:** `get_project_standards({ shard: "vibe-crud" })`  
> **Workflow:** [`vibe-coding-workflows.md`](./vibe-coding-workflows.md) § WF-2  
> **Playbook:** [`vibe-operator-playbook.md`](./vibe-operator-playbook.md)

---

## When to use

User is on **Client Components** (`pageKey: client-components`) and wants a new grid + form CRUD bound to an API.

**CRUD Set** (one `CrudSet`: list + creates + purpose/content patches + delete, Users-like): load shard `crud-set` and skill `.claude/skills/appendo-crud-set`. Ask `CRUD_SET_FIRST_QUESTION`, fill `CrudSetSpec`, then render one `CrudSet`. This vibe shard is the leftover path for a one-off grid/form that is **not** a CRUD Set.

## Execute — do not re-ask

If the user already described the CRUD (entity, columns, API), after retrieve call **`draft_component_layout`** — do not ask them to repeat. For a **multi-page application** (list+detail, portal with several screens), call **`draft_application_scaffold`** instead (orchestrates shell + pages + menu via `draft_component_layout`).

## Tool order

1. `get_feature_graph({ pageKey: "client-components" })`
2. `search_codebase` + `read_file` — similar layout/template
3. **`draft_component_layout`** (single screen) **or** **`draft_application_scaffold`** (multi-page + shell + menu)
4. Proposal → confirm → apply → **Designer handoff**

## UI rules (mandatory)

| Control | Use |
|---------|-----|
| Grids | `AppTableGrid` |
| Booleans | `UiCheckbox` — never native checkbox |
| Buttons | `AppButton` intents from `buttonSemantics.ts` |
| Modals | `CreateEditModalShell` |
| Labels | `ps-[4px]` + 2px gap to control |
| Page guide | Every generated field must have `label` + `hint` (plain-language sentence). Auto-form/CRUD builders emit `hint`; canvas/export wrap the control with `data-page-guide*`. After a manual `designer_insert_palette_item`, set `hint` via `designer_set_prop`. |

## Related shards

- `crud-set` — unified `CrudSet` (`CrudSetSpec` as props); prefer this over this shard
- `crud-pages` — CRUD page patterns
- `ui-grid` — columns, paging, actions
- `ui-core` — forms, shell, typography
- `data-studio` — when the API is generated from a Data Studio model
- **`package-ui`** — operational package Phase 3 gate (lists · main/rail editors · vocab · scaffold); use for CMS/CRM-style packages instead of inventing chrome
- `package-base-info-vocab` — shared Base Info vocab form for package settings
